displayName: Monitor brand and keyword mentions across the web
summary: Get a weekly digest of everything being said about your brand.

useCases.title: Monitor brand and keyword mentions across the web
useCases.message: Set up a weekly brand monitoring routine. You might want to start with my company name and product as default keywords. If you don't already know where I prefer to receive summaries, ask. Then set up a Routine that searches for mentions across news, LinkedIn, and Reddit each week.
